mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_csat_survey (session_id, scope_id, score, `comment`, invited_at_ms, submitted_at_ms) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{scopeId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{invitedAtMs}, #{submittedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), `comment` = VALUES(`comment`), submitted_at_ms = VALUES(submitted_at_ms)
